name: Email Agent
description: Gmail-backed A2A Google Workspace agent for email, group notice email, calendar invites, Google Docs, and Google Sheets workflows.

skills.name: Search Email
skills.description: Search Gmail message metadata using Gmail query criteria.
examples: Find Bob's last email.
Search unread messages from alice@example.com.

skills.name: Read Email
skills.description: Read Gmail messages, optionally including body text and attachment previews.
examples: Read the latest unread email.
Read the last email from Bob with the message body.

skills.name: Draft Email
skills.description: Prepare a structured email draft from user instructions and optional workflow artifacts, including optional high-importance headers; Gmail draft creation can be performed directly.
examples: Draft an email to Bob with two meeting options.

skills.name: Send Email
skills.description: Send email through Gmail directly, including multiple explicit recipients and optional high-importance priority headers.
examples: Send this email to Bob.
Send the test email to wyy0115@outlook.com and tomsonlee13@gmail.com.

skills.name: Send Group Email
skills.description: Send one Gmail group notice message directly using the Email Agent's configured group delivery mode.
examples: Send the group notice email.
Send the group notice email with high importance.

skills.name: Summarize Thread
skills.description: Read matching Gmail messages and return a concise thread summary.
examples: Summarize the thread with Bob.

skills.name: Google Workspace Status
skills.description: Check Google Workspace dependency, OAuth token, credential, and scope status.
examples: Check whether Google Workspace OAuth is configured.

skills.name: Current Time
skills.description: Return the email agent's current local time and timezone.
examples: What time is it for the email agent?

skills.name: Calendar Status
skills.description: Check Google Calendar dependency and OAuth status.
examples: Check whether Calendar access is configured.

skills.name: List Calendar Events
skills.description: List Google Calendar events in a time window.
examples: List my calendar events for tomorrow.

skills.name: Create Calendar Event
skills.description: Create a calendar event and optionally email calendar invites to attendees directly.
examples: Create a calendar invite for Friday at 2pm and email it to Alice.

skills.name: List Google Docs
skills.description: List Google Docs visible to the authorized account.
examples: Find my recent Google Docs about the project.

skills.name: Read Google Doc
skills.description: Read plain text from a Google Doc by document ID.
examples: Read this Google Doc by ID.

skills.name: Create Google Doc
skills.description: Create a Google Doc with optional initial content directly.
examples: Create a Google Doc titled Meeting Notes.

skills.name: Append Google Doc
skills.description: Append text to an existing Google Doc directly.
examples: Append these notes to the project Google Doc.

skills.name: Replace Google Doc Text
skills.description: Replace matching text in an existing Google Doc directly.
examples: Replace TODO with Done in this Google Doc.

skills.name: Create And Email Google Doc
skills.description: Create a Google Doc and email its link to recipients directly.
examples: Create a Google Doc with this plan and email the link to Bob.

skills.name: List Google Sheets
skills.description: List Google Sheets visible to the authorized account.
examples: Find my spreadsheet about expenses.

skills.name: Read Google Sheet
skills.description: Read values from a Google Sheet range.
examples: Read Sheet1!A1:D20 from this spreadsheet.

skills.name: Create Google Sheet
skills.description: Create a Google Sheet with optional initial rows directly.
examples: Create a spreadsheet with these rows.

skills.name: Write Google Sheet
skills.description: Overwrite values in a Google Sheet range directly.
examples: Write these rows to Sheet1!A1.

skills.name: Append Google Sheet
skills.description: Append rows to a Google Sheet range directly.
examples: Append this row to the tracker spreadsheet.
